personal_info.name: Nan Jiang
personal_info.title: Quantitative Researcher | Alpha Modeler | Data Scientist

summary: Economics PhD with 3+ years of experience building and deploying quantitative equity strategies in live trading environments. Expert in alpha modeling, ensemble learning, and portfolio risk systems with proven track record of managing client assets in SMAs. Proficient in Python, R, and SQL, with hands-on experience across the full quant research pipeline—from model development to automated execution in live markets.

positions.title: Quantitative Researcher
achievements: Developed machine learning-based equity ranking models achieving 31% returns (Jan 2024-Oct 2025) for long-only strategies and 39% returns with 0.17 beta (Jan 2024-Oct 2025) for long-short strategies in live SMAs
Engineered unified Python risk management system with VIX-adjusted exposure limits, ATR-based trailing stops, HHI concentration controls, and real-time monitoring capabilities

Automated end-to-end trading pipeline using Refinitiv, IBKR APIs, JPMorgan Neovest, and Webull API with custom basket algorithmic execution; conducted weekly strategy diagnostics and performance optimization

positions.title: Financial Analyst

positions.title: Senior Associate – Fixed Income Underwriting
